scenarios.name: Industrial Solvent Discharge
scenarios.description: Upstream factory discharge event with rising turbidity and solvent signature, clear single-source localization.

ticks.note: Initial anomaly detected at industrial corridor.
Contamination signature reaches downtown intake sensor, confirming downstream spread.

scenarios.name: Agricultural Runoff (False Positive)
scenarios.description: Naturally elevated turbidity following rainfall; no chemical signature and no regulatory violation. Tests that the swarm does not over-escalate.

ticks.note: Mild turbidity rise, pH and conductivity remain within normal range — consistent with runoff, not a discharge event.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous Multi-Source Event
scenarios.description: Two simultaneous anomalies (solvent signature at CF-14, heavy-metal signature further downstream) forcing the swarm through multiple reasoning iterations before confidence clears the threshold.

ticks.note: Second, distinct signature downstream — low initial confidence, triggers additional Sensing Agent iteration before Hydrodynamic hand-off.
